capabilities: Send the open note, its front matter metadata and embedded images to Lareia
Update the same text on resend instead of creating a duplicate
Pair each Obsidian install with a Lareia account via a one-time code
Write a lareia-leitor identity line into the note's front matter
Exclude chosen ## sections from the send
disambiguation: Not a reader, listener or study tool inside Obsidian; it only packages and sends the note to the Lareia app, where reading happens.
extras: Free within the account's sending limits; enforces size caps (4 MiB note, 32 MiB with images) and refuses oversized sends on-device; bilingual English/Portuguese interface; not affiliated with Obsidian.
problem: Notes in the vault can't be read or listened to in the Lareia app without manually copying text and images over, and repeated sends would pile up duplicates.

relations.evidence: sends a note from your vault to the Lareia app, with its images, to read, listen to and study there

summary: Sends an Obsidian note with its embedded images to the Lareia app to read, listen to and study there; resending updates the same text.
